media.alt_caption: A clay barn floating in a bright sky

steps.title: Hello from TeeBot
steps.prompt: Hey there! TeeBot is so happy to see you today. Let us explore together.

steps.title: Warm-Up
steps.prompt: TeeBot gives a big hello wave before we start.

steps.title: New Words
steps.prompt: Today we are visiting a barn! A barn is a big house for farm animals. We will also learn "farm" and "hay."
steps.helperText: Look at the picture and listen.

steps.title: TeeBot Shows You
steps.prompt: This is a barn. Listen: "barn." TeeBot will say it first, then you can try.
steps.helperText: Look at the barn and listen to TeeBot.

steps.title: Listen Carefully
steps.prompt: Your turn. You try: "barn." TeeBot is listening.
steps.helperText: Say the word when you are ready.

steps.title: Your Barn Word
steps.l1TransferHint: Let the child try freely first. Give support later if the parent asks for practice tips.

steps.title: What do you see?
steps.prompt: TeeBot says: This is a ___. You can say barn.

steps.title: Great Listening!
steps.prompt: I heard you. Nice speaking with TeeBot. That word is "barn."
steps.helperText: Support the child for responding, without judging the sound.

steps.title: Barn Star!
steps.prompt: You found the barn with TeeBot! Look how your garden is growing!
steps.parentSummary: Today your child practiced place words (barn, farm, hay) by listening, trying, and speaking back to TeeBot. Try asking "What is this?" while looking at farm picture books.

sourceReferences.title: Oxford Phonics World - Sample Pages

vietnameseRelevance.notes: Use the spiral sequence for low-pressure listening and speaking turns.

sourceReferences.takeaway: Use 4-step spiral: warm-up -> model -> child practice -> supportive review.
sourceReferences.limitations: No Vietnamese L1 support. English-only audio. Requires adaptation for low-pressure child turns.
